metadata.title: Bilingual Business, Workplace & Tech Glossary (English <-> Roman Urdu)
metadata.description: Standard professional terminology for real-life business, operations, and IT environments.

revenue.example: Company ka revenue is quarter mein 20% barh gaya.

profit.example: Net profit pichle saal se behtar raha.

loss.example: Operations mein hone wale loss ko control karna zaroori hai.

margin.example: Profit margin maintain rakhna zaroori hai.

budget.example: Naye project ke liye budget approve ho gaya.

forecast.example: Agli maahi ki sales forecast bohot achi hai.

audit.example: Accounts team internal audit ki tayyari kar rahi hai.

investment.example: Technology mein investment se efficiency barhti hai.

expense.example: Fizool expenses ko kam karna hoga.

invoice.example: Client ko invoice email kar di gayi hai.

receipt.example: Payment ki receipt accounts mein jama karwa dein.

billing.example: Billing cycle har maah ki 25 tareekh ko close hota hai.

cashflow.example: Healthy cash flow business ke liye lazmi hai.

payroll.example: Maheenay ke aakhir mein payroll process hota hai.

contract.example: Client ne 2 saal ka contract sign kar liya hai.

agreement.example: Dono parties ke darmiyan agreement tay pa gaya.

vendor.example: Naye vendor se rates negotiate karein.

client.example: Client ke sath meeting kal subah 10 bajay scheduled hai.

customer.example: Customer feedback service ko behtar banati hai.

stakeholder.example: Sabhi stakeholders ko progress update bhej di gayi hai.

proposal.example: Client ko detailed proposal submit kar diya gaya.

approval.example: Management se budget approval mil gayi hai.

compliance.example: Company policies ki compliance lazmi hai.

policy.example: Company ki return policy clear hai.

risk.example: Risk management har business ka ahem hissa hai.

strategy.example: Agli quarter ki marketing strategy tayyar hai.

milestone.example: Team ne project ka pehla milestone waqt par achieve kiya.

target.example: Monthly sales target achieve ho gaya.

kpi.example: Har employee ke KPIs set kar diye gaye hain.

efficiency.urdu: mehnat aur waqt ki bachat / efficiency
efficiency.example: Automation se operational efficiency barh gayi.

productivity.example: Staff ki productivity improve karne ke liye training zaroori hai.

scalability.urdu: barhne aur phailne ki gunjaish / scalability
scalability.example: System ki scalability ka jaiza lein.

meeting.example: Daily standup meeting 15 minute ki hoti hai.

agenda.example: Meeting ka agenda pehle se share kar dein.

minutes.example: Meeting ke baad minutes of meeting note karein.

deadline.urdu: aakhri tareekh / waqt ki pabandi / deadline
deadline.example: Project ki deadline Friday sham 5 bajay tak hai.

schedule.example: Weekly production schedule release ho gaya.

timeline.example: Project timeline ke mutabiq chal raha hai.

follow-up.example: Client ke sath email par follow-up lein.

status update.example: Task ka status update board par mark karein.

feedback.example: Manager ne report par positive feedback diya.

presentation.example: Board meeting mein presentation deni hai.

summary.example: Document ka khulasa shuru mein diya gaya hai.

assignment.example: Har team member ko unki assignment mil gayi.

responsibility.example: Quality check karna supervisor ki zimmedari hai.

delegation.example: Effective delegation se time bachta hai.

escalation.urdu: masle ko baray afsar tak pohanchana / escalation
escalation.example: Agar issue resolve na ho toh escalation karein.

priority.example: Is order ko top priority par rakhein.

backlog.example: Pichle haftay ka backlog clear karna hai.

workflow.urdu: kaam ka nizaam aur rasta / workflow

sop.example: Har kaam SOP ke mutabiq hona chahiye.

shift.example: Night shift mein extra staff zaroori hai.

overtime.example: Delivery meet karne ke liye overtime lagana para.

attendance.example: Biometric machine par attendance mark karein.

leave.example: Annual leave approve ho gayi hai.

onboarding.urdu: naye mulazim ko kaam sikhana / onboarding
onboarding.example: New joiner ki onboarding complete karein.

handover.urdu: kaam ka charge doosre ko dena / handover
handover.example: Chutti par jane se pehle handover document karein.

shipment.example: Export shipment port par deliver ho gayi.

delivery.example: On-time delivery hamari pehli tarjeeh hai.

dispatch.example: Finished goods warehouse se dispatch ho gaye.

inventory.example: Inventory audit har maah hota hai.

warehouse.example: Raw material warehouse mein shift kar dein.

procurement.example: Fabric procurement team market gayi hai.

supplier.example: Supplier se fabric delivery ki confirmation lein.

fabric.example: Fabric quality lab mein test ho rahi hai.

garment.example: Export quality garments pack ho chuke hain.

raw material.example: Raw material ki quality achi honi chahiye.

lead time.urdu: order se tayyari tak ka waqt / lead time
lead time.example: Is fabric ka lead time 15 din hai.

defect.example: Stitching mein koi defect nahi hona chahiye.

rejection.example: Quality failure ki wajah se lot reject ho gayi.

rework.example: Rejected pieces ko rework line par bhejein.

inspection.example: Final inspection report clear aayi hai.

quality assurance.urdu: meyar ki tasdeeq / QA / quality assurance
quality assurance.example: QA team sample check kar rahi hai.

batch.example: Batch number label par print karein.

throughput.example: Line balancing se throughput barh gayi.

bottleneck.example: Ironing section production ka bottleneck hai.

capacity.example: Factory apni full capacity par chal rahi hai.

logistics.example: Logistics partner shipment pick kar raha hai.

cargo.example: Air cargo ke zariye emergency delivery bheji.

data.example: Data analysis se trends samajh aate hain.

dataset.example: Clean dataset model training ke liye zaroori hai.

database.example: Database backup har raat generate hota hai.

query.urdu: sawal ya talash / query / SQL query
query.example: Database se query run kar ke records fetch karein.

analytics.example: Power BI par analytics dashboard tayyar hai.

dashboard.example: KPIs dashboard par live update ho rahe hain.

chart.example: Bar chart mein monthly sales dikhayi gayi hain.

graph.example: Trend graph upar ja raha hai.

table.example: Data table Excel format mein export karein.

spreadsheet.example: Spreadsheet mein calculations auto update hoti hain.

formula.example: Sum aur average ka formula lagayein.

calculation.example: Totals ki calculation dobara check karein.

sort.example: Data ko ascending order mein sort karein.

trend.example: Market trend AI ki taraf ja raha hai.

insight.example: Data se ahem business insights milin.

prediction.example: Model sales ki accurate prediction karta hai.

agent.example: LangGraph agent tasks ko automate karta hai.

pipeline.example: Data processing pipeline automate ho chuki hai.

automation.example: Repetitive tasks ki automation se time bachta hai.

script.example: Python script data clean karti hai.

deploy.example: Application production server par deploy ho gayi.

bug.example: Testing team ne login bug report kiya.

fix.example: Developer ne code fix kar diya.

feature.example: Naye release mein export feature add hua hai.

api.example: REST API ke zariye backend connect hota hai.

sync.example: Data ko cloud ke sath sync karein.

async.urdu: alag alag waqt par chalna / asynchronous
async.example: Async tasks background mein chalte hain.
